orchestrating_use_cases.note: Repricing and revenue redistribution are NOT performed; recorded as accepted financial-staleness debt.

transaction_ownership.note: Controllers no longer open the campaign-booking or reschedule transactions; the use cases own them. DB::transaction(..., attempts:5) is used for retryable deadlocks.

exceptions.App/Application/Booking/Exceptions/Booki: Carries HTTP status and payload so Application can express 422 rejections without importing App\Http.

open_debt: Report-side read models under app/Application/Reporting use DB and Cache facades directly (62 facade call sites across Application). This is accepted for reporting read paths; consolidating them behind repository interfaces is a larger phase.

not_consolidated.CreateCampaignBookingUseCase vs ManualBo: Deliberately different: campaign booking derives authoritative amounts from CampaignPricingService; manual booking is a multi-channel flow with its own finance/audit/commission side effects.
not_consolidated.CreateOfflinePaymentUseCase vs ManualBoo: Deliberately different: differing status vocabularies, receipt requirements and settlement triggers.
